audit.why: content win[] is all Milio; phases[].side reads the generic 'Skill' token on every row, the same systemic pattern seen on the other matchups in this slice — left alone per the chart rule.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit; several fields were templated filler shared with other matchups.
audit.why: Lint flag plus the user's quality bar require concrete cooldown numbers.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now cites Breath of Life's 160/145/130s cooldown and Cozy Campfire's 29-21s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Milio's sustain (Cozy Campfire heal-zone, Breath of Life team heal) was never tied to an anti-heal timing call.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags Grievous Wounds timing as unstated for this matchup.

edits.before: - Milio Breath of Life: matchup-defining — The team-wide cleanse-heal undoes your CC chain — force it early, engage after. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your E Battle Dance answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Breath of Life (R) is 160/145/130s and cleanses your charm outright — bait it with a throwaway engage before you commit your real one. - Cozy Campfire (W) is 29s down to 21s; its heal-zone outpaces chip damage, so time anti-heal before an extended trade, not during.

edits.before: Level 2-3 windows govern; level 6 hardens the playbook; first item funds it.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 his Cozy Campfire sustain out-heals your poke; level 6's Breath of Life cleanses your charm; his kit stays ahead until your CC chain has a second source to beat the 160s R.

edits.before: Zone with the threat — the button you hold governs more than the one you press.
edits.after: Ultra Mega Fire Kick (Q) knocks back mid-dash and Cozy Campfire heals the chip back — bait the 10s Q before you W in, not after.

edits.before: Window economy: convert the ganks, start the rivers, peel the picks.
edits.after: Force his defensive tools first — Warm Hugs (E) has two charges but only one Breath of Life; bait the cleanse with a throwaway engage before your real all-in.

edits.before: Carry by windows — one clean play per fight; your carry does the arithmetic.
edits.after: Carry only with a second CC source — Breath of Life cleanses a solo charm outright, so pair your engage with your carry's lockdown before committing.

edits.before: You decide the fights your team attends — start them, peel them, or poke them out of existence.
edits.after: His Breath of Life undoes a lone Quickness engage — bait it out with a feint charm, then commit the real one once his 160/145/130s R is spent.

edits.before: Ahead, dance louder: entrance Milio's carry off every window and charm the recovery formations.
edits.after: Ahead, bait Breath of Life with a throwaway engage, then charm for real once it's down — his kit has no second cleanse.

edits.before: Q the pair for the heal, W the window, E home — the trade paid twice and answered once.
edits.after: Pair your charm with your carry's own CC — a solo engage into an up Breath of Life gets cleansed and shielded away.

edits.before: That is Milio’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: Cozy Campfire's heal-zone outpaces chip damage on its own — bring anti-heal before an extended trade, or you're just feeding his sustain.

edits.before: Entrancing into a banked disengage — the bird that flies into tornadoes writes the highlight for the other team.
edits.after: Committing your only charm into an up Breath of Life — it cleanses and shields the whole backline, wasting the engage outright.
